product.title: Petrecerea de Halloween
product.description: Când o fetiță este găsită moartă, înecată, după ce s-a lăudat că a văzut o crimă, faimoasa scriitoare de romane polițiste Ariadne Oliver îl cheamă pe vechiul său prieten Hercule Poirot pentru a-l descoperi pe ucigaș. Cine și de ce ar fi avut motiv să omoare un copil nevinovat? Poate că povestea spusă de Joyce nu era, până la urmă, una dintre obișnuitele ei minciuni, menite a-i impresiona pe ceilalți? Poirot va trebui să facă apel la toată ingeniozitatea sa pentru a descâlci misterul unor decese și al unei dispariții suspecte, dar mai ales pentru a împiedica săvârșirea altor crime.

# Petrecerea de Halloween: A Classic Whodunnit Mystery Novel by Litera

Dive into a gripping tale of deception and death with *Petrecerea de Halloween*. This compelling mystery novel plunges readers into a dangerous world where secrets are buried deeper than any grave. Fans of classic crime fiction and brilliant detective work will find themselves completely engrossed in this thrilling whodunnit published under the trusted Litera brand.

## The Mystery of the Vanishing Girl

The story begins with a devastating discovery: a young girl is found deceased, having drowned. Adding to the tragedy, she was allegedly seen by witnesses who claimed they observed a crime taking place. Faced with such grim circumstances, the renowned detective Ariadne Oliver calls upon her old friend, Hercule Poirot, for assistance.

Who murdered this innocent child? The central question drives the narrative as Poirot begins his meticulous investigation into the suspicious death and the potential disappearance of other individuals.

## Unraveling Deception: A Cast of Suspects

As Poirot applies all his ingenuity to solve the case, he encounters layers of lies and half-truths. One particular storyâa tale recounted by Joyceâcasts a shadow over the proceedings. Is this narrative merely an attempt to impress others, or is it hiding a much darker motivation?

*Petrecerea de Halloween* challenges readers to question every testimony and suspect every motive. Poirot must confront not only the cold case of the child's death but also prevent other crimes from being committed, making his investigation complex, emotional, and utterly suspenseful. This book is perfect for those who love intricate plots and masterful detective work in mystery fiction.

---

*   **High Stakes Plot:** The mystery combines elements of death, disappearance, and uncovering deep secrets, ensuring thrilling page-turning action.
